description: Sample: a short-lived address for an edition's current file, the same one shop.take hands out, which the app downloads to a temporary file, checks against contentCID, opens at its first pages and discards. Nothing is added to the account. The server counts samples per account without the book, apart from takes, and counts no edition.

main.description: Requires the caller's service token. The first sample or take of a version may take up to a minute while the server copies it from its source.

contentCID.description: CIDv1 (raw, sha2-256, base32) of the file's bytes.

errors.name: DailyCap
errors.description: The account has opened 30 samples today (UTC). Takes have their own cap.

errors.name: SourceBusy
errors.description: The Shop has copied all it may from its sources today.

errors.name: SourceFailed
errors.description: The source refused or the file didn't arrive.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such edition, or it is hidden.
